 The Charlotte 49ers take on the Tulsa Golden Hurricane in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Kickoff is set for 2:00 p.m. EST on ESPN+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Tulsa is favored by 22.5 points on the spread with a moneyline of -2500. The total is set at 52.5 points.
 Here's my Charlotte vs. Tulsa prediction and college football pick for Saturday, November 21, 2026.
 Charlotte vs. Tulsa Pick: Under 52.5 or Better 
 My Tulsa vs. Charlotte best bet is on the Under. Find the best line available on our live NCAAF odds page .
 Charlotte vs Tulsa Odds
 Charlotte vs Tulsa point spread : Tulsa -22.5 (-110), Charlotte +22.5 (-110)
 Charlotte vs Tulsa over/under : 52.5 (-105o / -115u)
 Charlotte vs Tulsa moneyline : Charlotte +1100, Tulsa -2500
 This game triggered one of our Action PRO betting systems, powered by Evan Abrams :
 High Humidity Low Temp Unders is a college football system that captures how difficult playing conditions affect offensive performance.
 During the regular season, games played in environments with humidity above 60% and temperatures below 70 tend to slow scoring.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Heavy air makes passing less effective, limits kicking distance, and increases fatigue for skill players.
 When these conditions are combined with steady wind above eight MPH, the ball becomes harder to control, and mistakes are more common.
 These factors consistently push scoring below expectations, yet betting markets often fail to fully adjust.
 By isolating these weather-driven matchups, the system identifies games where the under delivers strong long-term value.
 The weather report calls for temperatures around or below 70 degrees, with consistent 15-MPH winds and gusts up to 25 MPH.
 That's a poor weather report for two offenses that throw the ball at top-50 rates nationally.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Pick: Under 52.5 or Better
